_scope: Theme Park World SLES-026.88, PAL, image at 0x80010000. Guest arrival interval and head-count. Tags: SOURCED (read off code at the address), MEASURED (observed live via fable/a/wrunner from states/park_ride.state + btn/in_idle.txt, 1 sim tick = 2 frames), DERIVED, UNMEASURED.

model.kind: fixed real-time bus loop; park contents set head-count per bus only
model.admission_gap_note: spawn->pay latency 333..372 creeps +10/cycle then snaps back; underlying spawn period is 694
model.closed_form: T = ceil(0xC8000/d) + 3*ceil(0x50000/d) + drive(31,d) + drive(44,d) + 2 + hold; drive(n,d) ~ (n*65536-32768)/d + 11; d = [0x80103A90] per sim tick

delta_per_tick.unit: RCnt2 IRQ count << 7; RCnt2 target 0x866 at sysclk/8 = 1969.1 Hz

pseudocode: if phase==2: if batch==0: batch=2 elif batch==1: return (HOLD)
if phase==1 and IsOpen() and held==0: Arrivals(McAi,0)
if phase>wrap: phase=1; A=0xC8000; pos=table[0]<<16; tgt=table[1]<<16
bus_tick.model_validation: fable/a/bussim.py reproduces phase/pos/A/B bit-exactly for 1499 ticks, 0 mismatches (MEASURED)

0x80103964.name: bus_phase
0x80103964.values: 1 drive in, 2 at gate, 3 instant, 4 drive off

0x80103958.name: gate_batch_state
0x80103958.values: 0 idle, 1 admitting, 2 bus present no batch

0x80103844.name: flat-ride list; first node = [+8], object A = node+8

headcount.formula: count = min(cap - guests_now, min(20 - lanes, floor((S + [0x80102E54]) * 0x1333 / [0x80102E50])));  if [0x80102E60]!=0: count = min(20 - lanes, 20)
headcount.score: 0 if no attraction placed, else 10 + sum(terms)

terms.ride (types 1,3,6,7): (20 + rand(10) + level*intensity + (age<=1 day ? 20 : 0)) / 2   [0x800674C8; level=A+0xF6, intensity=vslot53, age=McAi+0x10 - A+0xF4; bonus ALWAYS added (delay slot 0x80067528), +20 only when (age<<12)/2024 < 4]

fixture_park.ride: 0x801E3A78 flat ride, day built 131, total days 147, age 16, level 0

gate_coupling.hold: bus waits in phase 2 while batch==1; measured phase-2 durations with 7 guests/bus: [34,34,34,34,222,178,34] ticks -> cycles of 883 and 839
gate_coupling.batch2_clear: batch 2->0 only when pos > 0x190000 (25.0); a phase-4 target <= 25 freezes admissions (MEASURED with table[3]=17: wait climbed to 2, gate_total froze)

knobs_measured.why: bus never passes 25.0, batch stuck at 2

knobs_measured.note: 60 spawned in 3000 frames, not 120; gate_total rose 400 per admission on the empty park

not_a_knob.0x80103A90: rewritten from the root counter every tick before the bus reads it; a held poke is overwritten

falsifiers: hold [0x80102D40]=1 from park_ride.state: 4th spawn at frame 2926 (clock 16493), spawns 656 frames apart; baseline 4th spawn is frame 5122
hold [0x80102D40]=1 and [0x800E0F0C]=15: spawns every 262 frames from frame 564
hold [0x80102E54]=100: guest count 2->9 at frame 958, 9->16 at frame 2346
